data_source: Official PlayStation trophy list (names, descriptions, grades, hidden flags) as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase before the 2026-11-19 competition opened. Guides, categories, chapters, missable flags and this roadmap are original work for this entry, written from the official descriptions and the games' public structure (GTA V trophy design; GTA VI setting: Leonida, Vice City, Jason and Lucia). No Rockstar assets are used. The app itself makes no network requests.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum. Earn every other trophy in the list — all 54. Use the roadmap: finish the story first, then activities, collectibles, crime side jobs, and grind the counters. Sources: official description; roadmap modelled on PowerPyx/PSNProfiles platinum roadmaps.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Play the opening mission of Jason and Lucia's story in Leonida to the end. Source: official PlayStation description; mission list per PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story progression. Every main chapter mission in Chapter 1 must be completed; the trophy pops when the chapter's credits card rolls. Source: official description; chapter structure per Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story progression for Chapter 2. No side content is required, only main missions. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story progression for Chapter 3, the arrival in Vice City. Source: official description; chapter naming per PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story progression for Chapter 4. Source: official description.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold trophy for finishing the final mission of the story. Once credits roll the story is done; keep a manual save before the last mission if you want to replay it. Source: official description; grade per Exophase.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Unmissable while playing the story. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a main-story heist mission. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play, a family-themed story mission. Source: official description.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown at the airport. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a late-story mission. Source: official description.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold trophy for 100% Completion. In the tradition of GTA V's 100% checklist (missions, hobbies, collectibles, random events), finish every tracked objective listed in the Stats menu. Do collectibles and activities as you go so the checklist never surprises you. Sources: official description; 100% structure modelled on GTA V per PowerPyx GTA V guide.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Silver. Complete 250 Stunts (jump and stunt-score events across Leonida). Grindable in free roam; use stunt ramps near Vice City Beach for repeats. Count per official description; approach per PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once: fishing, races, shooting range, arcade, meditation and the rest of the activity menu. The trophy tracks one attempt per type. Source: official description.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver. Earn gold in every Shooting Range challenge (42 tracked challenges per Exophase/PSNProfiles). Practice each weapon class; gold thresholds reward speed and accuracy. Source: official description plus challenge count cited from Exophase's GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Check the race markers on the map and win once per course. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races (not 20 wins on one track — they must be distinct). Mix street, off-road and sea races. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge once his strand unlocks. Source: official description; character strand naming per PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any arcade cabinet game once (an homage to GTA V-style minigames). Find an arcade in Vice City. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's stranger strand (a GTA V 'Strangers and Freaks'-style side story). Source: official description; strand structure per PowerPyx GTA V guide.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton, another stranger strand. Source: official description.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy's strand. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver. Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and more). Source: official description; strand count per PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy's strand. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone's strand. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot marked across Leonida — a collectible-style checklist. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for, part of his hunting strand. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver. Finish 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are found across the map like GTA V's action figures; a set completes when all its cards are collected. Source: official description.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver. WAiNK It at 100 locations — the graffiti/AR-tag trend of the trailer era. Each tagged location counts once. Source: official description.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges (the game's trick/challenge score system). Stack challenges in free roam; the count is tracked in stats. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level together with your partner and escape the heat. Trigger high heat in a two-character section and drive until the search cone clears. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level — plan three close stores and move fast between them. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles (drive or steal distinct models; the discovery log tracks them). Source: official description.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus, the new slow-mo ability. Best attempted on a large camp or ambush with plenty of targets. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — drive a vehicle through the airport gates or run the runway in spectacular fashion. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — steal and drive a Rhino tank (military base infiltration, wanted level guaranteed). Source: official description; the quote references Vice City-era tank jokes per community notes.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — case the store, approach quietly, and finish before the alarm. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver. Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Each vault robbery needs planning gear and an escape route; five separate jobs count. Source: official description.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape — blow or stop the truck on the highway, grab the cash and evade. Source: official description.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — visit every map region (Vice City, the Keys, the swamps, Grassrivers and the north). Fog-of-war clears as you pass through. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — find the marked operations (chop shops, labs, dens) and hit one per gang. Source: official description; gang roster per trailer material.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — buy a drink at an Ocean Beach bar overlooking the water. A light free-roam moment trophy. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a supercar through the showroom glass. Likely missable if showrooms close during late-story lockdowns; do it as soon as you reach Vice City. Source: official description; missability reasoning per PSNProfiles-style caution.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — finish a bowling game (a GTA IV bowling nod). Source: official description.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Hidden trophy. 'A partnership with mass appeal' — earned through a story event with Jason and Lucia's public profile rising. Keep playing the main story; it unlocks with the relevant mission. Source: official description; reasoning per PSNProfiles hidden-trophy placement.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Hidden trophy. 'Choices made (for better or worse)' — tied to a major story decision. Missable in the sense that it requires reaching that branch; make a manual save before late-story choices. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Hidden trophy. 'Second time's the charm' — a story moment about a second chance; unlocks in a specific late mission. Source: official description.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Hidden trophy. 'What the hell just happened?' — earned at a surreal story beat near the end. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock down pedestrians or targets using a melee weapon from a moving vehicle near the bowling alley setup. Fiddly one-off; flag noted as potentially missable per community guides. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from heists and robberies; funnel them through laundering contacts until the total hits. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, guns, food, vehicles all count toward the total. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Requires late-game money; buy each garage listing on the property market. Source: official description.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — use the app on your in-game phone while on a scooter-friendly vehicle 10 times. Source: official description.
